Lauren / team — ran the reconciliation against our CRM and put together a draft ownership_matrix_v1.csv and a short notes doc. Key highlights: 

- Overlap: ~72 accounts flagged as "double-owned" across AtlasForge and Redwood territories (mostly mid-market fintech + two enterprise retailers).
- Proposed split heuristic: enterprise (ARR >$250k) -> Redwood primary / AtlasForge co-sell; mid-market ($25k-$250k) -> split by region-first owner; low ARR < $25k -> AtlasForge primarily.
- Exceptions: 8 accounts already in active Dedicated conversations (we should treat them as Redwood-exclusive unless AtlasForge brings a closed-won reference).

  3) Marissa to draft short co-sell routing SOP and intro template.
